surface: search_library normalization for Hebrew transliteration variants
summary: search_library has documented-and-working separator normalization (space/hyphen/underscore/case) BUT no phonetic Hebrew-transliteration tolerance. David's real failure mode (Lechu/L'chu/Lekhu/Lekhu Neranena/Nranina spelling drift) returns zero matches across 6 variants when the chart isn't named identically
repro: 6 spelling variants of 'Lechu N'ranina' all return zero matches even though Psalm 95 is a common Kabbalat Shabbat opener. For an entry that DOES exist: 'Ein Keiloheinu' returns 3 matches; 'Ein Keloheinu' (dropped i) returns 0; 'Ayn Keloheinu' returns 0; 'EIN KELOHEINU' (case-insensitive but drops the i) returns 0. Documented separator normalization PASSES: 'Shalom Rav', 'Shalom-Rav', 'Shalom_Rav', 'shalom rav', 'Shalom  Rav' all match 3 charts; only 'shalomrav' (no separator) misses.
observed: Zero phonetic tolerance for dropped/added vowels, h/kh/ch consonant variants, apostrophe-as-shewa
expected: Either (a) phonetic-tolerance algorithm (Soundex / Metaphone / hebrew-specific transliteration table), OR (b) explicit doc note that David must use the exact catalog spelling — and a periodic 'normalize-catalog-titles' job to reduce variant proliferation

summary: Library has NO chart matching 'Lechu/L'chu/Lekhu' anything — Psalm 95 (Kabbalat Shabbat opener) is absent OR catalogued under a wildly different transliteration

expected: Either chart exists (and search is too brittle to find it — see C7I1-012), OR chart is genuinely absent (and David's weekly Kabbalat Shabbat flow has no PDF for the opening psalm — surface to Daniel)

summary: Setlist owned by a test-* uid whose user-record is already removed becomes a PERMANENT firestore orphan — both delete_setlist (ownership-gated, returns 404 to admin) AND cleanup_all_test_data {prefix} AND revoke_test_account {uid} fail to sweep it
repro: (1) create_test_account uidPrefix=c7i1 mints uid A; (2) clone_setlist_from_template under uid A creates setlist S; (3) test session bearer rots prematurely (see C7I1-011); (4) cleanup_all_test_data {prefix:'c7i1'} returns removed:1 (a different newer c7i1 user) but setlists:0 cascade; (5) revoke_test_account {uid:A} returns revoked:true, authDeleted:false, cascaded.setlists:0; (6) delete_setlist {id:S, force:true} as admin returns 404 setlist_not_found (admin doesn't own; list/delete are ownership-gated); (7) list_setlists as admin doesn't surface S either. S survives.
observed: Permanent orphan setlist invisible to user-facing list_setlists but live in Firestore
expected: Either (a) revoke_test_account cascade always sweeps owner_id-matched setlists regardless of auth-user existence, OR (b) cleanup_all_test_data {prefix} sweeps all docs where ownerId starts with prefix (not just docs owned by still-extant test users), OR (c) admin override on delete_setlist to bypass ownership-gate for cleanup (admin can do anything)
